internal.title: Resolved: High Kafka Consumer Lag in Accounting Service
internal.body:
At 10:34 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert for high Kafka consumer lag was triggered in the accounting service. Diagnosis confirmed the issue was related to Kafka consumer lag, supported by the kafkaQueueProblems flag and relevant metrics. The mitigation involved disabling the kafkaQueueProblems flag at 10:53 UTC, which led to verified recovery with stable error ratios. The incident is now resolved.

Timeline:
- 10:34: Alert received
- 10:53: Diagnosis confirmed Kafka consumer lag
- 10:53: Flag kafkaQueueProblems disabled
- 10:53: Recovery verified with stable error ratios

Please review the postmortem for detailed analysis and lessons learned.

external.title: Service Interruption Due to Message Queue Delay Resolved
external.body: Between 10:34 and 10:54 UTC on 2026-11-08, the accounting service experienced delays in processing messages from its message queue, which may have impacted some operations. The issue was identified and resolved promptly, and normal service has been restored. We apologize for any inconvenience caused.

output.summary: High Kafka consumer lag caused delays in the accounting service message processing, resolved by disabling a problematic flag.
output.impact: The accounting service experienced message processing delays, potentially affecting transaction processing during the incident window.
output.root_cause: High Kafka consumer lag due to issues flagged by kafkaQueueProblems, resolved by disabling the flag.
output.resolution: The kafkaQueueProblems flag was disabled, which restored normal message consumption and service operation.

lessons.lesson: Monitor Kafka consumer lag metrics closely and have automated flag controls to quickly disable problematic flags to restore service.
lessons.applies_when: When kafkaQueueProblems flag is enabled and accounting service error ratio is elevated.

action_items: Implement automated alerting and flag management for Kafka consumer lag issues.
Review and improve Kafka consumer lag monitoring thresholds and response procedures.
